# Fronz

> Fronz helps founders get understood by customers and found by AI: lean go-to-market systems you own, not agencies you rent. Founded and run by Stacey Fronek.

Fronz is a productized growth-systems practice for seed–Series B founders and lean teams (roughly 1–30 staff). The model is sprint, then a scoped engagement you own, with light on-demand support. No monthly retainers. Every method is built live at the founder's own company, Moxa, first.

## Services

- [GTM Clarity](https://fronzz.com/gtm-clarity): Positioning and go-to-market clarity so customers understand what you do. Entry: GTM Clarity Jam, $1,500 (2-hour 1:1, recorded): a working session that separates what you sell from how people find it, decides your position, cuts to the one urgent customer, and produces a pitch sentence, a focus wedge, and a 90-day plan you own. Ladder: Jam $1,500 → Outreach Playbook from $7,500 (Jam fee credits 100%) → GTM Build, custom-scoped 12-week engagement.
- [Groundswell AI Customer Discoverability](https://fronzz.com/groundswell): Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) built on authentic community consensus: making AI engines cite your brand. Short form after first use: Groundswell. Entry: Visibility Audit, $1,500. Ladder: Audit $1,500 → Authority Build from $15,000 → Authority Engine, custom-scoped.

## Support model

- One-time builds you own; no mandatory monthly retainer.
- Team enablement included in every build.
- On-call hours: prepaid 10-hour packs at $250/hr.
- Refresh, booked anytime (no cadence): Groundswell $1,200.

## Free resource

- [GTM Clarity Starter](https://fronzz.com/starter): a free 20-minute exercise to map your offers, customers, and tactics on one page.
